summary: This informational memo is a guide to finding useful information on the Internet, as a way to improve on how hard it was to locate resources then. The author describes techniques to make useful sources easier to reach, with the goal of hiding the route to them.

eli5.summary: The Internet is full of treasure, but finding it is tricky. This paper is like a treasure map, showing ways to find good information more easily.
